news.title: Americans Are Increasingly Pessimistic About Avoiding the Worst Effects of Climate Change
news.summary_en: About six-in-ten Americans say countries around the world, including the U.S., will not do enough to avoid the worst effects of climate change. This growing pessimism is driven by Democrats.

news.title: Worldwide, a quarter of new car sales are electric vehicles or hybrids
news.summary_en: In eight countries, at least half of all new cars sold in 2025 were electric or hybrid. The U.S. reached just 10%, well below the global average of 25%.

news.title: In several European countries, EU gets more positive ratings today than during Brexit vote
news.summary_en: EU favorability has risen across Europe since the 2016 Brexit vote, with a median of 62% now viewing the organization positively.

news.title: Right-Wing Populism in the Decade Since Brexit
news.summary_en: Right-wing populist parties have had a political impact in other European nations over the past decade. These include the Netherlands and Poland, where such parties have led governments or been included in governing coalitions. news.title: How much do you know about NATO? Take our quiz
news.summary_en: Test your NATO knowledge and see how you compare to U.S. adults. Americans answer half of five factual questions correctly, on average.

news.title: What Political Issues Do Americans Hear About in Church?
news.summary_en: Most U.S. adults who go to religious services say they’ve recently heard from their clergy about at least one political or social issue.

news.title: Trading volume on prediction markets has soared in recent months
news.summary_en: Prediction market trading volume has risen from under $5 billion monthly in mid 2025 to nearly $24 billion in April 2026, with sports dominating.

news.title: 10 facts about Americans and marijuana
news.summary_en: Nearly nine-in-ten U.S. adults say marijuana should be legal either for medical or recreational use. Just 11% say the drug should not be legal at all.
